Great choice
Feb 2020
This cafe was the perfect choice on a overwhelmed day. We stopped by this place after visiting the main attractions in the midtown during the morning. We made a big brunch to rest and keep going. We ordered benedict eggs (I was really missing them), 2 ham and cheese croissants and toast with avocado, with two vietnameese coffees, everything delicious. And to take away we got a watermelon and a passion fruit juice. We got a discount and they were fresh and with lots of fruits!! We actually came back on our second day around before taking our bus to Cat Ba. We felt a bit at home in this cute and chill cafe. Super recommended!!

reviews.review_text:
Rogeli Z
2 contributions

"Everything delicious and great service"
Feb 2020
Perfect place to rest a bit from the crazy Hanoi. Great location and different from other coffee shops: here you can find high quality drinks and food and a friendly and fast service. We took some delicious coffees: we really wanted to try the traditional coffee with egg...and it was a good shot! A friend, less risky, took it with condensed milk. We also bought some toast with salmon and with benedict eggs. Also, happy choices. And to take a way, with a discount of 10%, we took some real fresh natural juices to keep going with our walking tour. Location is perfect as well, just in the heart of Hoan Kiem district.
